uv lock
git add uv.lock pyproject.toml
caption: Without a committed lockfile, two developers installing the same pin can still get different transitive dependency versions.

code:
envs/
  qiskit-env/   qiskit==1.2.4 pinned
  qsharp-env/   qsharp==1.9.0 pinned
caption: Separate environments per SDK, called via subprocess or a thin API boundary — not two incompatible ecosystems in one process.
